title: Pressure ulcers: site, stage and healing
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's pressure ulcer, if any.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow up of pressure ulcer.

HPI
Pt is a 78-year-old male presenting for wound care of a pressure ulcer on the right heel. Pt reports the wound has been present for several weeks. He notes some drainage but denies significant pain or systemic symptoms. He is currently using a pressure-reducing mattress and performs frequent weight shifts. He is compliant with current wound care regimen.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg QD
Atorvastatin 20mg QD
Aspirin 81mg QD
Meloxicam 15mg QD

Review of Systems
Constitutional: Denies fever, chills, or fatigue.
Integumentary: Positive for pressure ulcer on right heel. Denies other skin changes.
Musculoskeletal: Denies joint pain or new weakness.
Neuro: Denies numbness or tingling.
All other systems reviewed and negative.

Social History
Pt lives at home with spouse. Retired. No tobacco use. Occasional alcohol use.

Family History
Father: Hypertension, Stroke.
Mother: Heart disease.

Vitals
BP: 138/84
HR: 72 (RRR)
Temp: 98.6 F
SpO2: 97% on RA
Ht/Wt: 165 lbs

Recent Labs
HbA1c: 6.8%
eGFR: 65
WBC: 8.2
Hgb: 13.4
Hct: 40%

Exam
General: Pt appears well-nourished, in no acute distress.
Skin: Stage 3 pressure ulcer noted on the right heel. Wound measures approximately 3x2cm with visible granulation tissue and some slough. No surrounding erythema noted. Periwound skin intact.
MSK: Right foot stable.
Neuro: Sensation intact to light touch.

Assessment
1. Pressure ulcer, right heel. Currently stage 3.

Plan
1. Wound care: Cleanse with normal saline, apply hydrocolloid dressing to the right heel.
2. Continue current medications.
3. Instructed pt to maintain offloading of the right heel.
4. F/u in 2 weeks for wound assessment.

Electronically signed, T. Haddad, MD, 05/14/2026
explanations: Pressure ulcer of the right heel, stage 3: L89.613 (HCC 381).

distractors.why: The stage is documented: it decides the code and the HCC.
